user.title: Battery & Solar Setup
user.description: Tell the Peak Shaver about your battery system and solar forecast source.

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor reporting available battery energy in kWh
data_description.solar_forecast_entity: Solcast or Forecast.Solar sensor with hourly forecast data
data_description.battery_capacity: Total usable capacity of your battery system
data_description.base_load_kw: Your average hourly power draw during a typical day
data_description.min_safe_soc_kwh: Battery floor - the level you never want to go below

schedule.title: Rate Schedule
schedule.description: Set your TOU rate tiers and when the shaver should run its calculations.

data_description.midpeak_start_hour: When mid-peak rates begin - cheaper than peak, more expensive than off-peak
data_description.peak_start_hour: When the most expensive rates begin
data_description.peak_end_hour: When peak rates end and off-peak resumes
data_description.weekdays_only: Most TOU plans only have peak pricing on weekdays
data_description.schedule_hours: Hours to run overnight calculations, e.g. 3,4,5,6

notifications.title: Notifications & Seasonal
notifications.description: Configure notifications and seasonal battery preservation.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Send notifications when charging decisions are made
data_description.charge_threshold: Ignore charge amounts below this level
data_description.seasonal_preservation: Preserve battery at end of peak during low-solar months
data_description.seasonal_months: Months to preserve battery overnight, e.g. 11,12,1,2,3

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found in Home Assistant
error.invalid_time_range: Rate periods must be in order: mid-peak < peak < end
